Supreme Court Declines Plea on UP Mosque Demolition, Directs Petitioner to High Court

The Supreme Court has refused to hear a plea concerning the demolition of a 100-year-old mosque in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh. The court directed the petitioner to approach the Allahabad High Court for relief. The plea had alleged contempt of a 2024 bulldozer judgment.
